# TendersMW — Malawi Government & NGO Tender Directory

> TendersMW is the most comprehensive directory of government and NGO tenders in Malawi. We aggregate procurement opportunities from PPDA, MANEPS, government ministries, NGOs, and international organizations operating in Malawi.

## About
- [About TendersMW](https://tendersmw.com/about/): Who we are and how we source tenders
- [Methodology](https://tendersmw.com/methodology/): How we verify and categorize tenders
- [Privacy Policy](https://tendersmw.com/privacy/)
- [Terms of Service](https://tendersmw.com/terms/)
- [Disclaimer](https://tendersmw.com/disclaimer/)

## Guides
Practical guides for businesses looking to bid on tenders in Malawi:

- [How to Bid on Tenders in Malawi](https://tendersmw.com/guides/how-to-bid-on-tenders-in-malawi/): Step-by-step guide for first-time bidders
- [PPDA Procurement Guide](https://tendersmw.com/guides/ppda-procurement-guide/): Understanding the Public Procurement and Disposal of Assets Act
- [MANEPS Registration Guide](https://tendersmw.com/guides/maneps-registration-guide/): How to register with the Malawi National Electronic Procurement System
- [Tender Document Checklist](https://tendersmw.com/guides/tender-document-checklist/): Documents you need to submit a compliant bid
- [Procurement Methods in Malawi](https://tendersmw.com/guides/procurement-methods-malawi/): Open, restricted, and direct procurement explained

## Procurement Law
- [Malawi Procurement Law Reference](https://tendersmw.com/procurement-law/): Key legislation governing public procurement in Malawi

## Browse Tenders
- [Browse by Category](https://tendersmw.com/category/): Filter tenders by sector (Goods, Construction, Consulting, IT, Services, Health, Agriculture, Education, Energy, Transport)
- [Browse by Entity](https://tendersmw.com/entity/): Browse by procuring organization
- [Browse by Source](https://tendersmw.com/source/): Browse by tender publication source

## Data Coverage
- 170+ active and recent tenders tracked
- Government ministries, parastatals, NGOs, and international organizations
- 10 procurement categories
- Updated regularly from official Malawi procurement sources
